operations.summary: Get runtime logs of an app (v2)
operations.description: Current logs endpoint (v1 /logs only answers 'please upgrade your client'). Query: start (unix seconds), direction=forward, last_lines=false, optional releaseId. Response data[].values = [[timestamp ns, JSON string {_entry, type}]]. Source: Liara CLI (commands/app/logs.js).

operations.summary: Get build logs of a release
operations.description: Build output of a deploy: { release: {state, failReason}, buildOutput: [{stream: STDOUT|STDERR, line, createdAt}] }; query since = createdAt of the last line seen. Release states seen in the CLI: BUILDING, PUSHING, DEPLOYING, READY, FAILED, UNHEALTHY, CANCELED, TIMEDOUT. Source: Liara CLI (services/build-logs.js).

overrides.note: Required in practice (Liara CLI commands/app/create.js): planID from GET /v1/me plans.projects (g2 plans, available, region iran), bundlePlanID = an available key of plans.projectBundlePlans[planID], network = an _id from GET /v1/networks. platform one of node, laravel, php, python, django, flask, dotnet, react, angular, vue, static, docker, next, go.

Required in practice (Liara CLI commands/db/create.js): type is a key of GET /v1/me databaseVersions (postgres, mysql, mariadb, mongodb, redis, mssql, elasticsearch, rabbitmq, clickhouse); version is one of databaseVersions[type][].value; planID from plans.databases (g2, available, supports includes type); bundlePlanID = an available key of plans.databaseBundlePlans[planID]; network = an _id from GET /v1/networks.
Liara CLI commands/bucket/create.js: plan from GET /v1/me plans, permission public|private.

Docker image deploys (Liara CLI commands/deploy.js): body may contain image (e.g. ghcr.io/org/app:tag), port, type 'docker', envs [{key,value}], disks [{name,mountTo}], args [string], build {cache,args,dockerfile,location}, message.
